raw_segments.text: I fear that I must be a ridiculous teacher when I have so much difficulty in making myself
Like a bad speaker, therefore, I will not take the whole of the subject, but will break
a piece off in illustration of my meaning.
You know the first lines of the Iliad, in which the poet says that Chryses prayed Agamemnon
to release his daughter, and that Agamemnon flew into a passion with him, whereupon Chryses,
failing of his object, invoked the anger of the god against the Achaeans.
Now as far as these lines.
